records.rationale: Both paths reviewed. Retain GPL activate_task/deactivate_task, renamed wakeup_preempt, SMP set_task_cpu and stop_one_cpu_nowait interfaces. Native activation body is in __activate_task under the separately audited proxy wrapper; deactivate/preempt/stop bodies remain LTS and set_task_cpu adds only an observer. Source callers must hold required rq/pi locks and preserve on_rq/migration state; exporting does not make arbitrary task movement safe.

Retain GPL runqueues data export for Android scheduler source customization. Native DEFINE_PER_CPU_SHARED_ALIGNED layout/initialization remains. Callers must use per-CPU access and actual rq locking; no binary layout or unchecked userspace access is promised.

All three exports retained at current kernel/sched/syscalls.c location after split/reapplications 7a8142aaf68c and 2efa0b6495ee. Bodies match LTS. Checked APIs retain user=true permission/LSM handling; explicitly named nocheck API passes false for trusted kernel callers, not a new unprivileged syscall bypass.

Retain GPL wake_up_if_idle with whole function identical to LTS, including RCU handling and idle wake logic. Source caller must supply a valid CPU and respect CPU lifetime; export adds no scheduling policy.

Keep sched_feat_keys GPL export under existing CONFIG_JUMP_LABEL branch. Array is initialized from native features.h; callers manipulating static keys must use jump-label/static-key synchronization rather than write key internals. No historical array size/layout is frozen.

Retain uclamp_eff_value GPL export with native body. Historical idle_cpu export was explicitly replaced by available_idle_cpu in e750a0b5ec26 and reintroduced at its new syscalls.c location by 06f4268415ed. Keep that final interface, including vcpu_is_preempted check, without adding an obsolete idle_cpu export.

Both paths reviewed. Keep GPL __update_load_avg_blocked_se in current PELT code, whose native body remains below a default -1 Android override. Historical schedutil_cpu_util no longer exists in final ACK or LTS; current schedutil uses effective_cpu_util. Do not restore an obsolete compatibility shim. PELT override policy is separately audited; this row concerns exports only.

Retain sched_uclamp_used GPL static-key export with native false initialization. External scheduler code must follow static-branch enable/disable synchronization and matching accounting assumptions; this does not add a userspace permission bypass.

Keep GPL sched_setattr_nocheck at current syscalls.c location. Wrapper remains exactly LTS and explicitly passes user=false; privileged source modules must validate any untrusted request before calling it. Ordinary checked scheduling syscall path remains separate.

Keep GPL sched_switch tracepoint export for vendor monitoring. No event payload or switch-site behavior is changed by this commit. Probes must honor scheduler atomic context and pointer lifetime; observations do not grant a task reference.

Both exports retained: cpufreq_this_cpu_can_update and tick_nohz_get_idle_calls_cpu. Complete function bodies match LTS, preserving CPU-policy/RCU readiness checks and native tick counter access. Export does not serialize remote observation or provide a lifetime reference.

Full original visibility/export patch reviewed with explicit revert f6a7931247f0 and reapplication 662ee85cd13a. Final API includes bool first as fixed by 2bf32a8b1dd2; no obsolete two-argument shim is retained.

Keep GPL sysctl_sched_latency scalar present in pinned ACK. Full scoped source search finds only definition/export in delivered kernel/common-modules; EEVDF no longer uses it internally. This is explicitly an unconfirmed vendor source data interface, retained conservatively rather than inferred to be KMI-only from missing local consumers. Its value is not an operative native scheduler latency control; no former CFS scheduling calculations are restored.

Retain resched_curr GPL export; complete body remains native, including local/remote reschedule handling. Caller must hold the rq lock and satisfy interrupt/preemption context; no new synchronization is supplied by export.

Both paths reviewed. Keep nonstatic max_load_balance_interval, GPL export and matching scheduler header declaration under SMP context. Native HZ/10 initializer and current native update/use logic remain; callers modifying it can affect balancing latency and must synchronize appropriately. No fixed historical offset or binary layout.

Retain raw_spin_rq_lock_nested/raw_spin_rq_unlock/double_rq_lock GPL exports. All bodies match LTS, preserving core-scheduling lock-pointer recheck, preemption handling, IRQ-disabled assertion and rq ordering. Source modules must pair locks/unlocks and satisfy caller context.

Keep balance_push_callback GPL export using current struct balance_callback and native callback initializer. Do not preserve historical callback_head layout/cast. Callback list is protected by rq lock and must not be detached across the native split-balance interval.

Keep cpupri_find_fitness GPL export using current sched_ctx plus exec_ctx signature. Export patch adds no mask logic; current proxy-aware CPU-priority semantics are independently audited. Source callers must not use the historical single-task prototype or assume returned masks bypass subsequent affinity/hotplug validation.

Historical task_may_not_preempt helper/export is absent in final ACK and port. Its old task_thread_info preempt_count heuristic is replaced by current cpu_busy_with_softirqs and CONFIG_RT_SOFTIRQ_AWARE_SCHED active/pending masks; see softirq history review. Do not resurrect a removed API. This is explicit final source replacement, not missing-consumer reasoning.

Full remove/add patch reviewed. Remove old idle_cpu export and keep available_idle_cpu at final syscalls.c location. Native vcpu_is_preempted filter avoids reporting a preempted virtual CPU as available; no old-symbol compatibility shim.

Keep GPL task_rq_lock with complete body equal LTS. Both task pi_lock and current rq lock, migration state recheck and retry loops remain; callers must use matching task_rq_unlock and hold a live task reference.

Original nonstatic __balance_callbacks export is superseded by revert 2a8e9ffe59d2 and final reapplication 385520262421 with scheduler header declaration. Retain current struct balance_callback implementation rather than callback_head ABI.

Keep CONFIG_LOCKDEP-guarded GPL sched_domains_mutex export. Native mutex and locking helpers remain; this enables source lockdep assertions and does not add mutex storage in configurations where it already exists. SDK lockdep is disabled; generic build/config compatibility is retained.

Keep external visibility and GPL update_misfit_status export. Current native body is preserved except independently retained default-true need_update hook. Function belongs to SMP scheduler code; callbacks/callers must protect rq state. This export review does not claim correctness of arbitrary hook override policy.
Full removal reviewed. Later 385520262421 explicitly restores nonstatic __balance_callbacks/export and declaration. Do not apply temporary revert to final vendor source interface.
Full export removal/static restoration reviewed. Later 662ee85cd13a and 2bf32a8b1dd2 supply current set_next_entity declaration/export with bool first. Do not apply temporary revert.

Retain GPL wakeup_preempt export after scheduler helper rename. Whole body is LTS, including class comparison and clock-skip update; caller must hold appropriate rq state. No older check_preempt_curr symbol shim.
Both reapplication exports retained in syscalls.c. Native checked sched_setscheduler and trusted-kernel sched_setscheduler_nocheck wrappers remain; no syscall behavior is changed by export.

Both original helper relocation/export and header paths reviewed. Keep callable pick_task and matching current (rq, rf) declaration. Current class pick forwards rq_flags and can return RETRY_TASK as documented; callers must honor retry and rq-lock release semantics. Do not restore old one-argument wrapper or hide retry; current body otherwise follows native class iteration and idle-class guarantee. Related rq-lock-release fix is separately audited.
Both revert paths reviewed. Temporary NUMA-only restoration is superseded by later reapplications and final SMP-scoped 1d1d1e6f9558. Do not remove vendor source migrate_swap on this SMP non-NUMA SDK.

Both reapplication paths reviewed with explicit 3e977a9bed4b inverse and final 1d1d1e6f9558. Keep final SMP guard and NUMA-only trace call, rather than this intermediate unguarded definition/declaration arrangement.
Both inverse paths reviewed. Final 1d1d1e6f9558 provides migrate_swap under SMP with trace guarded by NUMA_BALANCING. Temporary revert is not applied to the final vendor source API.

Full declaration-only guard removal reviewed. Current internal __migrate_task declaration remains unconditional; no definition, exported symbol or UP execution path is added by this declaration. Actual x86 target is SMP; no assertion of a separate UP build.

Keep set_task_cpu export within enclosing CONFIG_SMP definition region. Final broader SMP block also encloses migrate_swap; export cannot reference an unavailable UP implementation. Verified current boundaries, without claiming UP build validation.

Both paths reviewed. Keep migrate_swap implementation/export under SMP and declaration in scheduler header; guard only NUMA trace call. All swap helper bodies are LTS apart from trace guard, preserving CPU-active checks, pi/rq locking, locked affinity/CPU rechecks and stop_two_cpus. This enables current non-NUMA SDK source customization; no affinity checks are dropped.

Keep nonstatic GPL __balance_callbacks and header declaration. Current body matches LTS except linkage and uses native splice(false) semantics, not historical callback_head layout. Must run under required rq lock, retaining balance-push callback ordering.

Both reapplication paths retained with final three-argument declaration fixed by 2bf32a8b1dd2. set_next_entity body is exactly LTS, including only protecting the slice when first=true. No reversal of LTS fair scheduling fixes to satisfy old prototypes.

Retain available_idle_cpu GPL export in syscalls.c after source split. Complete body matches LTS, including vcpu_is_preempted filter. Kernel callers must provide a valid CPU; function is an instantaneous observation, not a reservation.

Retain sched_stat_runtime GPL tracepoint export; no payload or runtime accounting site changed by this patch. Trusted probes must not sleep in scheduler atomic context or retain unreferenced task pointers.

Retain __scx_enabled GPL static-key export. SDK SCHED_CLASS_EXT=y; this is generic scheduler source customization. Initialization remains false and export does not authorize unsynchronized toggling or bypass SCX enable/disable machinery.

Retain ext_sched_class GPL export at current DEFINE_SCHED_CLASS(ext) definition. No class callbacks/layout are pinned by this export; use current compiled interfaces and SCX lifecycle. Export-only review does not certify all separate SCX policy changes.
Retain sched_setattr GPL export at current syscalls.c wrapper, which remains LTS user=true/pi=true. Exported checked API preserves permission/LSM path; no historical binary symbol-version promise.

Keep get_wchan GPL export with whole body equal LTS, including live task/stack-state synchronization. Kernel callers still need valid task ownership; export does not create an unprivileged kernel-address disclosure interface.
Both sched_waking and CONFIG_SCHEDSTATS-guarded sched_stat_sleep exports retained. SDK SCHEDSTATS=y. No event payload changes; probes must obey scheduler context and task lifetime.

Keep GPL sched_stat_wait/sched_stat_blocked exports inside existing CONFIG_SCHEDSTATS guard. No event definitions or accounting logic modified; source probes remain responsible for atomic execution and lifetime.
Keep GPL sched_stat_iowait export under CONFIG_SCHEDSTATS, configured for SDK. Export changes module visibility only; trusted probes must respect scheduler context.
Retain sched_wakeup GPL tracepoint export, without changing wakeup event fields or wake scheduling code. No claim of a known SDK probe; preserve generic Android module source compatibility.

Retain __sched_proxy_exec GPL static-key export inside CONFIG_SCHED_PROXY_EXEC branch. Current key starts true as in final ACK/LTS; no default-disable or new enable policy introduced by this export. Callers must use coordinated proxy lifecycle rather than raw key mutation.
Retain task_sched_runtime GPL export. Whole function matches LTS with task_rq_lock, current-task accounting and clock update; export adds no unprivileged caller path or task lifetime reference.

Keep raw_spin_rq_trylock GPL export. Body exactly LTS including core scheduling lock-pointer recheck and balanced preemption handling on failure/success. Caller must honor result and pair the current rq unlock primitive.

Retain final bool first set_next_entity prototype matching native current body/export. This preserves LTS only-protect-on-pick behavior and correct call ABI for rebuilt modules; no obsolete two-argument binary compatibility.

All three paths reviewed. Keep update_rq_clock GPL export with native body and final SMP migrate_swap interface/guards after reverts/reapplications. Old cpu_scale per-CPU definition/export is absent from final ACK and native arch_topology implementation; do not resurrect obsolete storage to mimic historic API. Current capacity interfaces remain native with separately retained topology hooks.

build_121_export_witness.excluded: sched_domains_mutex is CONFIG_LOCKDEP guarded and not emitted by this SDK configuration

scope: Full patches reviewed for all recorded candidates; scoped native body comparisons certify export-adjacent logic, not all scheduler policy in the touched files. Separate proxy/RT/SCX/PELT changes retain separate dispositions. No source changes or runtime scheduling tests in this group.
security: Rebuilt trusted modules may access scheduler data/functions and must obey current signatures, rq/pi lock ordering, CPU/task lifetime, RCU and static-key lifecycle. Checked/nocheck APIs retain distinction; userspace does not receive a direct new call. Native swap CPU/affinity rechecks and stop_two_cpus retained. Trace probes must not sleep in scheduler atomic context or retain unreferenced pointers.
uncertainty: Scoped C/header/Rust common-modules search did not find selected scheduler API consumers; absence is not a dispensability argument. Generic vendor source compatibility justifies conservative retention. sysctl_sched_latency remains as an ACK-exported scalar without internal EEVDF consumer, so actual vendor use remains unresolved; no native scheduling effect is claimed. No proof of historical-KMI-only purpose is available for that scalar.

subsequent_source_revalidation.method: All recorded export-adjacent function SHA256 values rechecked after isolated EAS helper/call restoration; unchanged. Build-121 symbol witness remains provenance for that build.
